correctness.rationale: By CRT, x^2 congruent 2q-1 mod 4q iff x is odd and x^2=-1 mod each odd prime-power factor of q. Hensel lifting gives two roots per prime power iff every p|q is 1 mod 4. Two generators per subgroup give 2^omega(q) groups. For u=least positive generator, its cube has residue 2q-u or 6q-u according as u<2q or >2q; therefore the subgroup sums equal 4q or 8q. The map x->x+2q is a well-defined, fixed-point-free involution on groups swapping the two sums. Independent integer subgroup enumeration tested every odd q=3..299 (149 moduli). The proof covers unbounded q, repeated prime powers.
residual_risks: q odd >1; the statement concerns only cyclic order-4 groups with designated involution 2q-1, not all quartic subgroups.
